experiences.title: senior software engineer
experiences.description: at ADP, I help build an internal AI Factory for software engineering. it uses agent harnesses, engineering loops, and multi-agent orchestration to plan, implement, validate, and review changes with different models. i contribute to the architecture and the way agents collaborate, turning open-ended problems into tools developers can use. work that previously took several weeks has already been completed in about one, with quality and model cost under control. before this, I was one of the main engineers on MyTax, working across Flutter, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and architecture.
highlights: on ADP's internal AI platform, I work on the architecture of agents that plan, write, test, and review code with different models.
one piece of work estimated at several weeks was delivered in about one, while keeping quality and model cost in view.
before that, on MyTax, I worked on bank integrations, automated IRS payments, and the architecture of a new Flutter app for US freelancers.
experiences.companyInfo: ADP builds products and services around payroll, HR, tax, benefits, and workforce management, serving businesses and workers around the world. i work within ADP's product and engineering organization on newer digital products and platforms.

experiences.title: software engineer
experiences.description: i worked on SAP Ariba Category Management, a product for strategic procurement. i built backend services with Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and SAP BTP, working through complex business rules and integrations between systems. i also integrated AI features, contributed to architecture decisions and code reviews, and helped teammates work through difficult technical problems. keeping changes understandable and maintainable mattered in a platform this size.
highlights: on SAP Ariba Category Management, I worked on AI recommendations used by customers in automotive, aviation, and technology.
i built services in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and SAP CAP, handling business rules and integrations between systems.
i also took part in architecture decisions and code reviews with a global team.

experiences.title: software engineer
experiences.description: i joined Bazk as a trainee and grew into a full-stack role, working on payment systems handling more than 400 transactions per minute. my work covered backend services, payment flows, compliance rules, internal tools, tests, infrastructure, and production monitoring. working with software that moves money taught me how distributed systems behave in practice, and why reliability, security, and observability matter.
highlights: i worked on payment and compliance systems processing more than 400 transactions per minute.
i built a Node.js rules engine to automate fraud and regulatory checks.
i started as an intern and was promoted twice in two years, reaching developer II.
experiences.companyInfo: Bazk was a fintech focused on payment infrastructure for e-commerce, handling payment processing, checkout flows, financial integrations, and compliance-related systems.

experiences.title: software engineer intern
experiences.description: my first software job was at Pling Brasil. i joined as a trainee and helped build Universos, a news aggregator based on web scraping. i worked on Node.js services and APIs, MongoDB integrations, and React interfaces. it was my introduction to building a product with a team, shipping code, and fixing problems once people could use it.
highlights: with a small team, I built Universos, a news aggregator using Node.js, MongoDB, and React.
experiences.companyInfo: Pling Brasil was a small software development startup building digital products and providing development services for clients.
